text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Come on Ayabe-san, let's go on a hike
before the training camp starts!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
After taking a deep breath of fresh mountain air,
our summer training camp officially begins!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

Before diving into the annual event,
the three of us decided to go mountain climbing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
…………
Even on a cliff like this... there's a path...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So it was true after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ayabe-san, what do you mean by 'true'?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: There was a path. For me, too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
My racing career was supposed to end at the Kikuka Sho.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Even now, she continues to race just like this.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
And this autumn, even after I settle things
with Opera O...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
—The road goes on.
That's what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san...
That's right. It must be so.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer-san?
choice_data_list: Yeah. As long as you keep running, always.
Yeah. For as long as we keep running.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"As long as I run, forever...
Yes, for now..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Breathing like this... is actually kind of fun.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, that's wonderful, isn't it?
Ayabe-san found her own path.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I feel like that worried feeling from before
has faded quite a bit.
choice_data_list: Yeah, this is all thanks to Top Road too.
Yes, and it's all thanks to Top Road.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Do you think so? I really hope so.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Setting Ayabe-san aside for a moment.
By the way, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I wonder what kind of path Trainer-san and I will walk from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In the spring, Opera O-chan was so overwhelmingly
strong that holding my ground was the absolute best I could do.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Still, autumn will be different. We can fight on equal terms.
If everything goes as well as it possibly can, I might even be able to surpass her purely on skill."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "If I can overcome this, true freedom lies ahead. For the sake of all the fans cheering for me, too..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I've been wondering what goal I should even be aiming for.

"The summit is finally in sight. That's precisely why
I can't help wondering what lies beyond once I reach it..."

The path after achieving one's primary goal. In other words,
this is a question of "how to live one's life"...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Right... I'm just not very good
at sorting through these kinds of things.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I'll give it my all! I want to give it my all!"
Since that's all that's kept me going, it hurts even more.

For the clumsy Narita Top Road,
it was a question far too obscure. In that case...
choice_data_list: Maybe I should settle things with T.M. Opera O first.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right.
Without having achieved that yet, thinking ahead might just be getting ahead of myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it, Trainer!
This autumn, I'll settle things with Opera O-chan once and for all.

T.M. Opera O was no longer an insurmountable Demon King.
Narita Top Road had grown enough
to fight her on equal ground.
This summer, we'll pick up the pace and climb higher and higher toward the pinnacle.
